About.title: About us
About.p1: posty.now is an AI assistant for social media. You talk, it drafts, schedules, and publishes — without bouncing between apps.
About.p2: One studio for captions, promotions, analytics, and timing. Built to feel quiet and fast, not crowded.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.body: We collect the account details you provide, the content you create in the studio, and messages you send through this site so we can operate posty.now. We do not sell your data. Contact us if you want a copy of what we store, or to ask that it be deleted.

Terms.title: Terms
Terms.body: By using posty.now you agree to use the product lawfully, keep your login private, and remain responsible for the content you publish to connected social accounts. The service is provided as-is while we grow. We may update these terms; the current version will always live on this page.

Accounts.title: Posting accounts
Accounts.intro: Connect through Zernio’s hosted OAuth. Facebook Pages, LinkedIn orgs, Pinterest boards, and Google locations use Zernio’s picker after login.
Accounts.connectedNamed: {platform} connected. You can publish from chat.
Accounts.connectedGeneric: Account connected. You can publish from chat.
Accounts.statsLimitedNoteBluesky: likes, comments, and shares only — no impressions/views
Accounts.statsLimitedTooltip: This platform provides limited analytics through its own API.
Accounts.blueskyIntro: Bluesky uses an App Password instead of OAuth.
Accounts.blueskyHelp: How do I get an App Password?
Accounts.audiencesReadonlyTooltip: You can read contact/company lists and engagement/website retargeting. New audiences cannot be created from Posty.
Accounts.audiencesUnavailableTooltipGoogle: Search and Display only, without audience targeting.
Accounts.audiencesUnavailableTooltipX: Location and language targeting only. Custom email lists are an advanced option and need at least 100 recently active users.
Accounts.adsNeedXFirst: Connect X on Posting accounts first, then connect X Ads.
